n-review.text:
How to review (about 5 minutes)
1. Press Play on Main. Press Sign in with nothing filled (summary + field errors), then a wrong address (“isn’t right”).
2. Sign in as rahul.verma@godavari.edu.in with any password. Account menu (top right) → Help & support → Report a problem → Send → View my reports → open it. Go to Home and back: the report is still listed.
3. Account menu → Sign out → “You’re signed out”.
4. Sign in as meera.iyer@godavari.edu.in and open the reopened and resolved reports in Help.
5. Board XS-03 · session ended: sign in as Meera → Not your workspace; as Rahul → back to the experiment.
6. Main’s Tweaks: scenario godavari-paused shows XS-08 to Godavari people. Signing out and in again keeps it.

n-accounts.text:
Sample sign-ins · any non-empty password
From the Phase-7 walkthrough: arjun.mehta@wilp.example (Super Admin) · meera.iyer@godavari.edu.in (Institute Admin) · rahul.verma@godavari.edu.in (Student, VR) · anil.shetty@northline.example (Vendor) · a.menon@wilp.example (Academic Reviewer) · kavya.nair@wilp.example (Content Manager).
Illustrative, this design only: s.ranganathan@godavari.edu.in (Faculty) · sneha.reddy@godavari.edu.in (Student, account inactive, v46 B7-04).
Any other address reads “The e-mail or password isn’t right”. None of this is shown in the product: there is no sample-user chooser.

n-rules.text:
Kept from v46 and the owner’s decisions
· No sign-up, role chooser (XS-02 stays excluded), “view as” or reset links. Forgot password and First time show the contact route only (T-11).
· Institution sign-in shows its unavailable state: real single sign-on isn’t connected (T-10).
· Super Admin Help shows no SUP numbers, accessible names included. Other roles keep theirs.
· Paused and inactive notices never change what a person may do.
· Pages owned by other workstreams are dashed preview slots, not product UI.
· V1 Public Landing untouched; the WILP logo slot stays reserved.

n-open.text:
Open, not decided here
· Identity provider and password policy (T-10); invitations and first activation (T-11).
· Contact route on Forgot password / First time for people with no institution administrator (Vendor, BITS staff).
· Whether platform roles show an organisation line in the account menu (v46 board 13).
· Showing a pause reason to institution people; support response promises (ND-14); notifications (T-34).
· A kept return address that belongs to another workspace shows Not your workspace here. Confirm against the app’s redirect.
